Introduction

Goeun is a South Korean singer and dancer under with RBW. She is a member of the girl group PURPLE KISS, with whom she debuted on March 15, 2021, with the mini album “INTO VIOLET”, and its title track “Ponzona”.

Prior to her debut in Purple Kiss, Goeun rose to fame after joining Mnet’s hit survival show, Produce 48, where she finished in 29th place.
